answer_1.quote: Table Answering (TQA) deals with answering natural language questions related to information organized in a table.
answer_1.outputs: natural language answers to questions based on tabular data

answer_2.quote: We use the following metrics. Exact match accuracy (Em) checks if the predicted answers and the ground truth are the same. ... Exact match difference (Emd, ... measures system performance change before and after perturbations ... Variation percentage (VP, ... measures to what extent predictions change before and after performing perturbations...

answer_4.quote: To distinguish between extraction and reasoning questions. They are told to classify whether a question is of type extraction or reasoning after giving the definitions and examples of each question type.
answer_4.guideline: We define extraction-based as: answers of the questions can be retrieved from table without numerical reasoning abilities. ... We define reasoning-based as: answers of the questions should be firstly retrieved from table and then numerical reasoning abilities are needed to obtain the answer.
